title: Stock insurer.
bodyText: A stock insurer is an incorporated insurer with capital stock divided into shares and owned by its stockholders to whom the earnings are distributed as dividends on their shares.
bodyHtml: [§431:3-110]  Stock insurer.  A stock insurer is an incorporated insurer with capital stock divided into shares and owned by its stockholders to whom the earnings are distributed as dividends on their shares. [L 2000, c 182, §1]
